items.question: What does an interior design project include?
items.answer: Space planning, material and finish selection, furniture and joinery design, lighting, and on-site execution through to handover.

items.question: Do you manufacture furniture and joinery?
items.answer: Yes. Kitchens, wardrobes, panelling and bespoke furniture are made in our own factory and installed by our team.

items.question: How long does an interior project take?
items.answer: A typical home interior takes 3–6 months from design approval, depending on scope and the amount of custom joinery.

items.question: How do you plan the budget?
items.answer: We agree a target budget at the start and share material options at different price points so decisions stay within it.

items.question: Can you work on an apartment that is still under construction?
items.answer: Yes — starting early lets us coordinate electrical, plumbing and ceiling layouts before they are fixed.
